name: Eaton (Cooper Power) Envirotran HDC 3000 kVA liquid-filled
description: Liquid-filled (Envirotemp FR3 natural ester) substation transformer designed for data centers, close-coupled to LV switchgear; 15/25/35 kV class primaries, 1000-5000 kVA. 3000 kVA is the most common data center size. Ratings from press; no Eaton datasheet opened.

capacity_w.note: press report: most commissioned units 3000 kVA (range 1000-5000 kVA); kVA x 1000 at assumed pf 1.0

efficiency.note: at 50% load. High: ~99.7% (press report). Low: DOE 2016 minimum for 3-phase liquid-immersed 2500 kVA, 99.53% (10 CFR 431.196(b)(2)); 3000 kVA is above the 2016 table, so the 2500 kVA floor is used

weight_kg.note: not published in the cited source

sources.title: The 'HDC' transformer: a liquid-filled transformer designed for large data centers (Consulting-Specifying Engineer, 2012)
10 CFR 431.196 energy conservation standards for distribution transformers (eCFR)
